Markus — thanks for the clear summary. I support a conditional exception with the following guardrails:

1) Approve consolidated quarterly invoicing (US + EU) for 12 months, contingent on:
   - Fully executed MSA and PO in HubSpot.
   - Customer signs a payment addendum acknowledging that Net-90 applies only to the named entities.
2) Approve Net-90 for US West Ops and Acme EU Ltd for 12 months with immediate effect, provided that:
   - Acme moves an initial deposit equal to one quarter's invoice (or we secure a letter of credit).
   - Finance gets ACH/credit-card pre-authorization on file.
3) If any payment is >30 days overdue once live, automatic pause on new provisioning for the affected legal entity and rolling collections cadence (CS + Treasury).

This exception expires in 14 days if not accepted by the customer — after that, revert to standard Net-30 monthly.

I will sign off from an executive standpoint; please document the addendum wording and confirm who on finance ops will implement consolidated invoicing and VAT mapping.

-Jonas

Couple operational caveats from Finance/Revenue Ops:

- VAT & EU invoicing: Consolidated "quarterly" invoices that span US + EU legal entities will create VAT reconciliation work and potentially require separate invoice documents per legal entity for compliance. Recommend we issue consolidated statements for the customer but maintain separate invoices per legal entity (same period).
- Systems: We need a Billing Ops task to create two invoice templates and a single statement feed. Estimated implementation: 4 business days once the addendum is signed.
- Risk mitigation: Instead of a full quarter deposit, consider a staged security hold: 30% up front, remainder 15 days after invoice receipt — reduces cash exposure while keeping the ask close to Acme's treasury needs.

I can have Finance Ops pick this up once legal finalizes addendum language. Also recommend we add a clause for automatic reversion to Net-30 if any entity misses 2 invoices in a rolling 6-month window.

- Grace
Sr. Manager, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
